# Example team handbook

## Support hours

Maintainers review escalated questions from 09:00 to 18:00 on business days.
The digital employee can answer at any time, but it must not claim that a
human maintainer is online.

## Access requests

Ask for the smallest permission that completes the task. Review the scope
before approval and avoid permanent authorization when a one-time grant is
enough.

## Incident reports

Include the application version, sanitized command, complete error category,
and the time window. Never paste access tokens, client secrets, private chat
exports, or customer data into a public issue.

## Knowledge freshness

Answers should cite the approved source. When two sources disagree, prefer the
newer source and state the conflict instead of guessing.
